L3666: message_thread_id  | Integer  | Optional  | Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only
L3667: question  | String  | Yes  | Poll question, 1-300 characters

L3677: hide_results_until_closes  | Boolean  | Optional  | Pass True if poll results must be shown only after the poll closes
L3678: members_only  | Boolean  | Optional  | Pass True if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll is being sent for more than 24 hours; for channel chats only

L3683: explanation_entities  | Array of 【65†MessageEntity】  | Optional  | A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the poll explanation. It can be specified instead of explanation_parse_mode.

item.text:
Задайте токен бота в переменной окружения `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`. Код отправит одну викторину: правильные ответы задаются через `correct_option_ids`, индексы Rust и Go — `[0, 2]`. [Документация Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpoll).

```python
import os

import httpx

token = os.environ["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]

params = {
    "chat_id": 123456789,
    "question": "Какие из этих языков компилируемые?",
    "options": [
        {"text": "Rust"},
        {"text": "Python"},
        {"text": "Go"},
        {"text": "Ruby"},
    ],
    "type": "quiz",
    "allows_multiple_answers": True,
    "correct_option_ids": [0, 2],
}

response = httpx.post(
    f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendPoll",
    json=params,
    timeout=30.0,
)
response.raise_for_status()

data = response.json()
if not data["ok"]:
    raise RuntimeError(data.get("description", "Ошибка Bot API"))

print("Викторина отправлена:", data["result"]["message_id"])
```
